 Love in Disguise – K-drama Episode 7 Recap & Review
 9 November 2026 by Rati Pednekar 
 Unrequited Love 
 Episode 7 of Love in Disguise begins with Yi-jun arriving at the amusement park to look for Jae-hee. Since the park is part of Taekang, Yi-jun orders the staff to look for her. He also tells the staff to allow a man and his old mother to enter the park despite it being after hours.
 While searching, he bumps into Jin-hyung and Jae-hee, and is surprised to hear Jin-hyung call her “dad”. While he remains shocked, Jae-hee takes Jin-hyung back to his mother, who is waiting by the entrance.
 Despite the park being empty now, Yi-jun takes Jae-hee to a train ride. The old woman from earlier is on the same ride with her son.
 On the train, Yi-jun tells Jae-hee that he knows Si-a was lying about hiring Jae-hee, but he used it as an excuse to come after her. He apologises for lashing out in the previous episode, saying that Jae-hee is the first person who broke through his walls. Now, he admits that he needs Jae-hee. Jae-hee declines a raise but asks him if she can hit him, and he agrees, with Jae-hee finally electing to flick him on the forehead.
 At the police station, the detectives wonder if Chief Ma is the one who alerted Kim Si-hyun about Hye-jun’s interrogation. Thanks to Si-hyun, the police don’t really get a lot of information out of her. But due to the images Secretary Han sent her, they now know about the existence of a slush fund.
 Later, when Jae-hee meets with her team to discuss the case, she mentions that Yi-jun isn’t a bad guy.
 A flashback shows Jae-hee asking Yi-jun to put on the lights to the merry-go-round for the old woman. He then made Jae-hee get on the ride with him and take pictures.
 That night, Jae-hee keeps thinking about how Yi-jun has been behaving really sweetly with her.
 Back home, Yi-jun tells Si-hyun that he’ll keep Jae-hee around since she’s the one nice thing in his life. Si-hyun points out that it won’t be easy to deal with unrequited feelings.
 In the morning, Yi-jun fusses over Jae-hee simply because her bus breaks down, making her walk to the house.
 At Taekang, an online forum reveals that Hye-jung and Si-hyun are dating. Si-hyun’s colleagues confront him about this and he admits they went on a date, after which he got dumped. Si-hyun later meets Hye-jung and tells her that Yi-jun wants to meet.
 When Yi-jun and Jae-hee arrive at the office, they end up pushed together in a crowded lift. Jae-hee is then told to go give a job satisfaction survey. During the survey, Jae-hee confesses that her boss’ behaviour has been strange lately.
 She later discusses the situation with her father, pretending to be talking about a friend who works as a secretary. In the process, she admits to feeling funny and confused around Yi-jun. Her father says the secretary should talk to his boss about it.
 That’s when Yi-jun calls Jae-hee, clearly in a sour mood, and tells her to meet him in ten minutes. Turns out, she never filled in the answer for evaluating Yi-jun on the job satisfaction survey.
 Jae-hee arrives at a restaurant on Yi-jun’s orders, where he gives her a rose and tells her to order whatever she wants. She straight-up asks him if he likes her.
 At the office, Si-hyun confronts Hye-jung, saying she knows why Secretary Han died but that she’s scared to do anything about it.
 At the restaurant, it turns out that Jae-hee is asking Yi-jun if he likes her the way he likes cats and action figures. At that moment, Si-hyun calls Yi-jun and arranges a meeting with Hye-jung. Hye-jung reveals that she gave Secretary Han a pen with a recorder so she could carry out Yi-jun’s orders perfectly.
 She replaced Han’s desk after her death in order to get the pen. Before allowing Yi-jun to take the pen, Hye-jung makes him promise to tell her everything he knows. Jae-hee recalls her previous behaviour and asks her if she’s being followed. Hye-jung admits that a strange man has been standing outside her apartment to keep an eye on her. He always wears the same shoes.
 Jae-hee records all of this on her phone and sends it to her colleagues. Seok-jun is worried about Jae-hee getting in too deep with Yi-jun.
 After the meeting, Jae-hee drives Yi-jun to the riverside since he seems to have a lot on his mind. He wants to find the slush fund owner because he knows it won’t be used for anything good, but he’s also worried about more people getting hurt because he started looking into this.
 In response, Jae-hee opens up about her past. She and Sergeant Go were sent on a hostage rescue mission when Jae-hee spotted a possible hostage. But she was mistaken. The boy turned his gun on her and Sergeant Go stepped in the way, getting hit fatally. This is why she left the military. But later, she came to regret it. Now, she advises Yi-jun to not run away.
 Yi-jun recalls saying that he would date Jae-hee if she were a girl back when they first met. Jae-hee asks him if that’s true and Yi-jun says it doesn’t make sense to entertain what-ifs, since “you are just you”. The scene ends with Yi-jun’s head on Jae-hee’s shoulder.
 Sometime later, Yi-jun takes Jae-hee to the tailor to get measured for a suit for an event where Yi-jun will be giving a big speech. Jae-hee tries to avoid it but ends up being forced to allow the tailor to measure her. Of course, he realises the truth about her gender and she asks him to keep it quiet, since she’s doing it to protect Yi-jun.
 At the police station, Seok-jun goes through CCTV footage of the man trying to find Park Min-hwan and catches a glimpse of a tattoo on his wrist.
 Back at the shop, Jae-hee asks Yi-jun and Si-a to step out of the room for the measuring. Just as she goes back out, Si-a sees her and purposely hugs Yi-jun, telling him she loves him. Yi-jun tries to explain the situation to Jae-hee but she formally says goodbye and walks away.
 The big event — a leadership and management awards night — kicks off. At one point, Si-a finds Jae-hee on her own and tells her she wants to be friends. When Jae-hee refuses, she reveals that she knows Jae-hee is a woman.
 Na-jung stumbles upon them at this point and Jae-hee is forced to agree to being friends with Si-a to stop her from revealing her gender to Na-jung. Yi-jun himself turns up here and pulls Jae-hee away from the other two.
 Elsewhere, Hye-jung arrives home while the detectives keep watch on her house. Si-hyun calls her and tells her he’s coming over with dinner.
 Back at the event, Yi-jun demands to know what’s going on with Jae-hee. Jae-hee tells him that Si-a should be his priority so that she stops getting the wrong impression. At that moment, a delivery guy wearing a helmet turns up at the door and gives Jae-hee a black box. Yi-jun looks inside and sees a black belt, the same kind that was used to kill Han.
 Outside Hye-jung’s house, the detectives realise that something is wrong. Inside, someone is choking Hye-jung!
 At the event, as Yi-jun starts panicking, Jae-hee goes after the delivery man. A still anxious Yi-jun is about to go give his speech when Si-hyun calls and tells him about the attack on Hye-jung. He realises Jae-hee is in danger as well and rushes after her.
 Outside the hotel, Jae-hee is about to stop the delivery man escaping on his bike when Yi-jun rushes in and stops her, pulling her to the ground. She wants to go after him but Yi-jun tells her to stay like this for a moment.
 The Episode Review 
 Episode 7 offers plenty of fun, shenanigans, and romance. The stronger Yi-jun’s feelings grow, the more entertaining things become. He has a full 180-degree shift in this episode, going from pushing Jae-hee away to pulling her closer towards him — sometimes literally. Now that Jae-hee’s feelings have come to the fore as well, the drama gets even more enticing. Romantic tension is in the air and we are eating it all up.
 Of course, it would be nice to get a better idea of what she likes about Yi-jun. It’s clear why Yi-jun is attracted to her, but we don’t really get the same insight into Jae-hee. The conversation with her father highlights her confusion but learning more about what pulls her to Yi-jun would make this development a lot more convincing.
 That said, the romance continues to be incredibly fun, featuring tropes like the amusement park scene and the crowded lift scene. The second half of the episode turns the dial up and focuses on the forbidden aspect of it all — not as two men, but as a chaebol heir and secretary for Yi-jun and as a cop and suspect for Jae-hee.
 It’s even more intriguing because both of them are coming at it from different places. The push and pull makes the relationship more tantalising and the presence of Si-a — a delightfully mischievous character — brings out some of the best reactions among the leads.
 The larger mystery doesn’t move along by much, although the humour and romance are enough to keep us occupied. Yi-jun and Si-hyun do officially join hands with Hye-jun. It’s only in the final scene that things really kick off again. The belt adds a splash of eeriness to the story and the attack on Hye-jun brings us back into dangerous waters.
 The logic of it all remains fairly weak. It’s a bit insane that the tailor simply chooses to keep Jae-hee’s big secret, as well as the fact that Jae-hee — a special forces-trained detective — would simply accept a black box from a mysterious delivery guy. However, the episode offers too much fun to linger over these gripes and we are eagerly awaiting the next one.
